description: Milestone gate definitions used by the Milestone Gatekeeper. Each gate lists entry criteria (must be true before the stage may start) and exit criteria (must be evidenced before the stage may be closed). Evidence is supplied by the operator as a map of criterion id to {passed, evidence}.

exit.criterion: Every file named in the request exists in the workspace
Every present file was opened and identified without error
Duplicate or superseded versions are resolved to one canonical path
Missing files were requested from the user instead of invented
Goal is restated in one sentence that the user can confirm
Every requirement has an id, an owner stage, and an acceptance check
Hard constraints are separated from preferences
Open ambiguities are either resolved or recorded as assumptions

entry.criterion: Assigned requirements are locked and prior stage outputs exist

exit.criterion: Every assigned requirement is produced by an identifiable artifact or record
Artifacts open or parse and are stored at their declared relative paths
Interfaces consumed by later stages match the declared merge contract
Requirement coverage is complete with no orphan requirement
Acceptance tests were executed and their results recorded
Known defects are repaired or disclosed to the user
Every artifact referenced by the plan is present and reopens cleanly
Naming, structure, and references follow the declared scheme
Temporary material is removed or excluded from the delivery
Delivery summary maps every requirement to its artifact
